neighbours.label: (guess) a sensory modifier noun in a description of how something tastes or looks: 'white peach', 'rich oil rubbed bronze', 'honey blonde'
fire: The candle gives off warm vanilla and black cherry notes as it burns.
This pendant light has a rich antique brass finish and amber shades.
On the nose there is ripe apricot and white pepper with a long finish.
The chair is upholstered in a soft dove grey linen with walnut legs.
The stylist suggested ash blonde highlights over a chestnut base.
Expect dark plum and cedar aromas from this bold Spanish red.
The tiles have a glossy sea green glaze with cream edges.
A subtle lemon zest flavour runs through the creamy goat cheese.
quiet: The candle was returned to the store because it arrived broken.
This pendant light must be installed by a licensed electrician.
On the shelf there is a box of spare bulbs with a receipt.
The chair is stored in the back room with the other furniture.
The stylist booked a second appointment for next Tuesday afternoon.
Expect the shipment from this Spanish supplier by the end of March.
The tiles were counted and stacked next to the loading dock.
A small invoice for the cheese came through the office mail.

short: sensory modifier in a product description (guess)
